title: The Domain Was Right
style: country folk slow burner, 76 BPM, male warm baritone lead, female harmony, pedal steel guitar, brushed kit, upright bass, acoustic strum, vinyl crackle, late evening porch energy, songpal lineage, was-right series
lyrics:
[Intro - pedal steel slide, acoustic strum, brushed kit warm]
(spoken, male, warm)
the domain was right.
long before the room understood it was a domain at all.

[Verse 1 - male warm baritone, pedal steel ribbons]
bought the name when nobody wanted it
held the name when everybody laughed
pointed the name at a thing they couldn't see yet
made the name a home for the working draft

they said it's just a name, it's just a string
you can't build a kingdom on a five letter thing
but the name was a doorway, the name was a door
and the door was a promise to the work that came before

[Pre-Chorus - female harmony enters, upright bass walks]
the domain was right
the domain was right
the name was the marker
for the long, long fight

[Chorus - full duet, pedal steel sings]
the domain was right, the domain was right
the name was a candle in a power-out night
the domain was right, the domain was right
long before the room could see the light
the domain was right, the domain was right
you pay the registrar a little every year
and the held line gets a little more clear
the domain was right

[Verse 2 - male, slightly fuller, kit warmer]
years go by and the name still points
years go by and the name still joints
the work to the world, the work to the wave
the name is the marker on the long line you save

for the moment when the room finally sees
what the name has been pointing at all these
years, all these years, all these holding-the-name years
and the name just smiles and the name stays clear

[Pre-Chorus]
the domain was right
the domain was right
the name was the marker
for the long, long fight

[Chorus]
the domain was right, the domain was right
the name was a candle in a power-out night
the domain was right, the domain was right
long before the room could see the light
the domain was right, the domain was right
you pay the registrar a little every year
and the held line gets a little more clear
the domain was right

[Bridge - acoustic alone, pedal steel low, spoken male]
a domain is not a website.
a domain is not a brand.
a domain is the smallest contract a person can make with the future.
a domain says i bet a little money that this name will matter.
a domain says i'll renew it every year because the work is worth it.
a domain says hold the line, hold the name, hold the door.
the room laughs at the small contract until the small contract holds the kingdom.
the domain was right.

[Final Chorus - biggest, pedal steel huge, female lead joins]
the domain was right, the domain was right
the name was a candle in a power-out night
the domain was right, the domain was right
long before the room could see the light
the domain was right, the domain was right
you pay the registrar a little every year
and the held line gets a little more clear
the domain was right
the domain was right

[Outro - acoustic fade, pedal steel last, male whisper]
the smallest contract held the biggest line.
renew the name. hold the door.
the domain was right.
